architecture_snapshot.active_target: F2-WP-507 generation 3 recipient-scoped GWT uptake/causal-evidence contract

candidate.name: GeMTest
candidate.observed_mechanism: MetamorphicTestCase stores explicit source_inputs/followup_inputs and source_outputs/followup_outputs; MetamorphicRelation executes the source SUT, applies a transformation to create follow-up inputs, executes follow-up SUT calls, and applies a relation over the paired observations.
candidate.wp507_transfer_hypothesis: Use the source/follow-up pair pattern as a structural donor for deterministic control/intervention probe fixtures around BroadcastEnvelope uptake. Keep F2-native exact broadcast/selection/plan/cell identities and tri-state evidence; do not import GeMTest as causal authority.
fit: paired source/follow-up observations map naturally to control/intervention runs
explicit transformation step can inspire deterministic intervention construction
relation evaluation can inspire fail-closed downstream-output comparison tests
pytest-oriented testing is compatible with repository-hosted component-CI research
mismatches_and_risks: GeMTest relation_result is boolean, while WP507 requires UNKNOWN/fail-closed treatment for missing or ambiguous evidence; direct semantic reuse could collapse UNKNOWN into false/no-effect.
GeMTest does not natively bind F2 broadcast_id/digest, selection generation/digest, GRID10 plan identity, recipient_cell_id, non-broadcast input digest or probe_id.

Full dependency surface is materially heavier than the current deterministic WP507 component: hypothesis, matplotlib, numpy, opencv-python-headless, pytest, pytest-html, pytest-xdist, typing_extensions and wrapt plus packaging support.
Metamorphic relation satisfaction is not proof of GWT semantic uptake or hidden-state causality.

counterhypothesis: The native WP507 G3 matched intervention/control contract may already encode all useful paired-run semantics. If GeMTest-derived transformation/relation structure adds no new falsifier coverage, reproducibility, or test-case generation benefit after exact F2 identity binding, it should be rejected rather than imported.
next_discriminator: At a later separately claimed E2, map only the minimal GeMTest source->transform->followup->relation state machine against the exact WP507 G3 ABI and count which fail-closed cases or deterministic probe-generation capabilities are genuinely new. Reject full dependency import unless measurable unique value survives.
